name: QuickBooks
purpose: Closes the learning loop. Actual labour, disposal, equipment, subcontractor and material costs per job flow back in so estimate accuracy improves against reality instead of against memory.

auth.notes: The Claude-side QuickBooks connector currently reports as requiring authorisation.

writes: invoice draft from awarded contract amount

known_limits: Job costing only works if every cost is coded to a job in QuickBooks; uncoded costs silently break the feedback loop.
owner_action_required: Authorise the QuickBooks connector in Claude connector settings before this can be built.
Confirm that jobs are tracked as Customers:Jobs (or Classes) so costs can be attributed per project.
